data.title: 神尾观铃 · 榻榻米上的纯白羽翼
data.description: 夜风吹开虚掩的木格窗，月光洒满整张席面。观铃顺从地任由细带睡裙滑落至腰际，纤弱的脊背弓起优雅的弧度，在一次次深情的温柔占有中发出了如释重负的啼鸣。

data.action: 观铃顺从地任由细带睡裙滑落至腰际，纤弱的脊背弓起优雅的弧度

data.promptProse: Lying on her back across the tatami floor beside an open screen overlooking the moonlit sea, Misuzu lets her thin-strapped white cotton-gauze nightdress slip down to her waist to bare her chest. Arching her slender back with parted lips and glistening tears, she glows in cool silver moonlight.
data.animaCaption: Lying back across the quiet tatami floor with her delicate white gauze nightdress slipped down to her waist, she arches her slim back with a heavy blush and glistening tears. Ethereal silver moonlight pours through the open sliding screen from the ocean horizon.
